name: Snow Radish Vacation!!
original_name: Snowラディッシュバケーション!!
source:
Snow Radish Vacation is the prequel to Summer Radish Vacation 1 and 2 and as such, also of School Days. Chronologically, it is the first in the "Radish continuity."

[From a post by Arinoch on Hongfire]

At the end of the year, in a snowy region...
There's a drive-in restaurant along a no longer used highway.
The name of the restaurant is Snow Radish.
It's managed by a mother and daughter, who are quite well known in the neighborhood. The daughter's name is Kagura, and she attracts customers with her pretty face. The mother's name is Moegi.
Now, to the matter at hand... Over winter vacation, Moegi's sister and her friends come to stay at the Snow Radish.
But one of the people Moegi's sister brings along is the cram school teacher Kagura used to have a crush on.
And so a busy, fun, but slightly sad, winter break begins.

[Translated from DLSite]
translation:
《雪萝卜假期》是《萝卜暑假》1和2的前传，同样也是《School Days》的前传。从时间上来说，它是“萝卜连续剧”中的第一部。

[摘自Arinoch在Hongfire上的帖子]

年底，在一片雪域……
一条不再使用的高速公路旁有一家汽车餐厅。
餐厅的名字叫雪萝卜。
它由一对母女经营，她们在附近颇有名气。女儿名叫神乐，凭借漂亮的脸蛋吸引了顾客。母亲的名字叫萌木。
现在，说到手头的事情……寒假期间，萌木的妹妹和她的朋友们来到雪萝卜旅馆住宿。
但萌木妹妹带来的人之一，却是神乐曾经暗恋的补习班老师。
就这样，一个忙碌、有趣、但又有点悲伤的寒假开始了。

[摘自DLSite]
